Photo 1: Closed laptop from top view, silver lid with HP logo. No visible model number or serial. Background shows shelves with other electronics.

Photo 0 and 2 show Intel Core i7 sticker on lower right of keyboard area.
No photo shows system information or BIOS. RAM cannot be verified from exterior photos.
No photo shows disk management, BIOS, or internal drive. SSD size cannot be confirmed remotely.
